newsitem.title: UK: Parkinson backs Hague in UK Conservative race.
newsitem.headline: Parkinson backs Hague in UK Conservative race.

text.p: Former Welsh Secretary William Hague's Conservative leadership chances received a boost on Tuesday when he won the backing of former cabinet minister Lord Cecil Parkinson.

Parkinson said in a statement Hague was the man with the conviction and appeal to lead the party, which was routed by Labour in the May 1 election, through opposition and back into power at the next election.

Hague is the leading candidate, along with former finance minister Kenneth Clarke, in the six-man race to succeed John Major. The leader will be selected by the Tory party's 164 surviving MPs, who will hold a first ballot next Tuesday.
